rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; on the reply format, not the tax reading. The prompt (.classm/classm.f8863.1.prompt.txt) lists the line as "line (CLW 1)"; the reply names it "CLW 1" without the parentheses, and the class M parser (tools/transcription/classm.py extract, line 287) strips only a leading "line " before matching, so the log records no answer (the known defect T-070 (1), T-081 (1); the reply for classm.f8863.2 writes "line (CLW n)" and was read). The case has f8863.paid false (no Form 8863: f8863.eligible false hides lines 1 to 19 on the values sheet) and Form 1040 line 18 $0.00, so every worksheet line is $0.00 on the project's values sheet (node engine/dist/main.js eval on the case inputs); the reply's value is $0.00, equal. A zero shown on a worksheet the filer does not reach is permitted (README); no project defect, and no expectation is recorded for a line without a parsed answer.
